articles.title_cn: 多评估者绩效评价与激励机制
articles.abstract_en: We compare evaluations of employee performance by individuals and groups of supervisors, analyzing a formal model and running a laboratory experiment. The model predicts that multirater evaluations are more precise than single-rater evaluations if groups rationally aggregate their signals about employee performance. Our controlled laboratory experiment confirms this prediction and finds evidence that this can indeed be attributed to accurate information processing in the group. Moreover, when employee compensation depends on evaluations, multirater evaluations tend to be associated with higher performance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们比较了个人和主管群体对员工绩效的评价，通过分析一个正式模型并进行实验室实验。模型预测，如果群体理性地汇总关于员工绩效的信号，多评估者评价比单一评估者评价更精确。我们的受控实验室实验证实了这一预测，并发现证据表明这确实可归因于群体中准确的信息处理。此外，当员工薪酬取决于评价时，多评估者评价往往与更高的绩效相关联。

articles.title_cn: 量刑决策的异质性影响
articles.abstract_en: We examine 70,581 felony court cases filed in Chicago, Illinois, from 1990 to 2007. We exploit case randomization to assess the impact of judge assignment and sentencing decisions on the arrival of new charges. We estimate separate treatment and outcome equations for first and repeat offenders. In marginal cases, incarceration creates large and lasting reductions in recidivism among first offenders. Yet among marginal repeat offenders, incarceration creates no lasting reductions in the incidence of new felony charges. Our results raise concerns about the ubiquity of sentencing rules that recommend or dictate relative leniency for first offenders.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了1990年至2007年间在伊利诺伊州芝加哥市提起的70,581起重罪法庭案件。我们利用案件随机化来评估法官指派和量刑决策对新指控到达的影响。我们分别对初犯和累犯估计了处理方程和结果方程。在边际案件中，监禁对初犯者的再犯率产生了显著且持久的降低。然而，在边际累犯中，监禁并未对新重罪指控的发生率产生持久的降低。我们的结果对普遍存在的建议或规定对初犯者相对宽大的量刑规则提出了质疑。

articles.title_en: Impact of an Early-Career Shock on Intergenerational Mobility
articles.title_cn: 早期职业冲击对代际流动性的影响
articles.abstract_en: Children’s and parents’ incomes are highly correlated, yet little is known about how early-career shocks contribute to this correlation. This paper focuses on a consequential labor market shock: job loss. We document three new results. First, adult children born into the bottom 20% of the income distribution have double the unemployment following job loss compared with those from the top 20% and 154% higher earnings losses. Second, this increases the rank-rank correlation 30% for those impacted. Third, richer parents provide career opportunities to their adult children after job loss, consistent with advantages from wealthy parents persisting well into adulthood.
articles.abstract_cn: 子女与父母的收入高度相关，但关于早期职业冲击如何促成这种相关性，我们知之甚少。本文聚焦于一个重要的劳动力市场冲击：失业。我们记录了三个新发现。首先，出生于收入分配底部20%的成年子女在失业后的失业率是来自顶部20%家庭子女的两倍，且收入损失高出154%。其次，这使受影响人群的排名-排名相关性增加了30%。第三，较富裕的父母在子女失业后为其提供职业机会，这与富裕父母的优势持续到成年期相一致。

articles.title_en: Two Sides of the Same Pill? Fertility Control and Mental Health Effects of the Contraceptive Pill
articles.title_cn: 同一药片的两面？避孕药对生育控制与心理健康的影响
articles.abstract_en: I investigate the link between access to the contraceptive pill, mental health, education, and labor market outcomes. Liberalizing education and labor market effects of access to the pill via its fertility control function are well established. More recently, however, a medical literature suggests a link between hormonal contraception and depression. Exploiting variation in access to the pill, I document substantial mental health effects of the pill. These mental health effects are driven by individuals with a genetic predisposition for depression who then do not experience the positive effects on education and labor market outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了避孕药的可及性与心理健康、教育及劳动力市场结果之间的联系。通过其生育控制功能，避孕药的可及性对教育和劳动力市场的自由化效应已得到充分证实。然而，近期医学文献提示激素避孕与抑郁之间存在关联。利用避孕药可及性的变化，我记录了避孕药对心理健康的显著影响。这些心理健康影响由具有抑郁遗传倾向的个体驱动，这些个体随后未能在教育和劳动力市场结果上体验到积极效应。

articles.title_en: Opening the Door: Immigrant Legalization and Family Reunification in the United States
articles.title_cn: 开门：美国移民合法化与家庭团聚
articles.abstract_en: Does opening the door to US citizenship for unauthorized immigrants cause out-of-control “chain migration”? We address this question using variation from the legalization programs of the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986 (IRCA). Exploiting IRCA’s introduction and differences across metropolitan areas in program intensity, we estimate that each IRCA-legalized Mexican was responsible for the subsequent immigration and legal admission of one relative, in total, through 2019. Most sponsored relatives were immediate family, and the adult sponsorship rate is inconsistent with out-of-control chain migration. Estimates using cross-country variation are substantively similar and suggest limited demand for reunification of extended families.
articles.abstract_cn: 让无证移民获得美国公民身份是否会导致失控的“连锁移民”？我们利用1986年《移民改革与控制法》（IRCA）的合法化项目中的变异来回答这个问题。利用IRCA的引入以及大都市地区项目强度的差异，我们估计每位通过IRCA合法化的墨西哥人，到2019年为止，总共负责一名亲属随后的移民和合法入境。大多数被担保的亲属是直系家庭成员，成人担保率与失控的连锁移民不符。使用跨国变异进行的估计在实质上相似，并表明对大家庭团聚的需求有限。

articles.abstract_en: Domestic outsourcing has grown substantially in developed countries over the past two decades. This paper addresses the question of the technological drivers of this phenomenon by studying the impact of the staggered diffusion of broadband internet in France during the 2000s. Our results confirm that broadband technology increases firm productivity and the relative demand for high-skill workers. Further, we show that broadband internet led firms to outsource some non-core occupations to service contractors, both in the low and high-skill segments. In both cases, we find that employment related to these occupations became increasingly concentrated in firms specializing in these activities, and was less likely to be performed in-house within firms specialized in other activities. As a result, after the arrival of broadband internet, establishments become increasingly homogeneous in their occupational composition. Finally, we provide suggestive evidence that high-skill workers experience salary gains from being outsourced, while low-skill workers lose out.
articles.abstract_cn: 在过去二十年中，发达国家的国内外包显著增长。本文通过研究法国在2000年宽带互联网逐步扩散的影响，探讨了这一现象的技术驱动因素。我们的结果证实，宽带技术提高了企业生产率以及对高技能工人的相对需求。此外，我们表明，宽带互联网促使企业将一些非核心职业外包给服务承包商，无论是在低技能还是高技能领域。在这两种情况下，我们发现，与这些职业相关的就业越来越集中于专门从事这些活动的企业，而在专门从事其他活动的企业内部执行的可能性降低。因此，在宽带互联网到来之后，机构在职业构成上变得越来越同质化。最后，我们提供了初步证据表明，高技能工人因外包而获得薪资增长，而低技能工人则遭受损失。

articles.title_en: The Contribution of Immigration to Local Labor Market Adjustment
articles.title_cn: 移民对地方劳动力市场调整的贡献
articles.abstract_en: The United States faces persistent spatial disparities in joblessness, which should theoretically be eliminated by population reallocation. Can immigration accelerate this adjustment process? I estimate that new immigrants account for 40% of local population adjustment since 1960. This vastly exceeds their share of gross migratory flows (just 10%). I attribute their “excess” response to the pull of migrant enclaves, which are disproportionately located in high-employment areas (a consequence of persistent shocks). However, immigration does not significantly accelerate population adjustment overall, as it crowds out the contribution from internal mobility. This crowd-out can help explain the contemporary decline in gross internal flows.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国面临持续存在的失业空间差异，理论上应通过人口重新配置来消除。移民能否加速这一调整过程？我估计，自1960年以来，新移民占地方人口调整的40%。这远超其在总迁移流量中的份额（仅10%）。我将其“超额”反应归因于移民飞地的吸引力，这些飞地不成比例地位于高就业地区（这是持续冲击的结果）。然而，移民总体上并未显著加速人口调整，因为它挤出了内部流动的贡献。这种挤出效应有助于解释当代总内部流动的下降。

articles.title_en: Interaction of the Labor Market and the Health Insurance System: Employer-Sponsored, Individual, and Public Insurance
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场与健康保险制度的互动：雇主提供、个人和公共保险
articles.abstract_en: We develop and estimate an equilibrium model with heterogeneous local markets, households, and firms, highlighting the interrelationship between various components of the health insurance system—employer-sponsored health insurance (ESHI), individual health insurance (HIX), and Medicaid—and their relationship with the labor market. We estimate the model exploiting variation across states and before and after the Affordable Care Act. We consider counterfactual policies that cross subsidize between ESHI and HIX, including pure ESHI-HIX risk pooling as a special case. We find that such policies would increase household welfare and output and decrease government expenditure and would be more effective with Medicaid expansion.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发并估计了一个包含异质性地方市场、家庭和企业的均衡模型，强调健康保险制度各组成部分——雇主提供的健康保险（ESHI）、个人健康保险（HIX）和医疗补助——之间的相互关系及其与劳动力市场的联系。我们利用各州之间以及《平价医疗法案》前后的差异来估计该模型。我们考虑了在ESHI和HIX之间进行交叉补贴的反事实政策，包括纯ESHI-HIX风险共担作为特例。我们发现，此类政策将提高家庭福利和产出，减少政府支出，并且在医疗补助扩展的情况下将更为有效。

articles.title_en: Geographic Mobility of Youth and Spatial Gaps in Local College and Labor Market Opportunities
articles.title_cn: 青年地理流动性与地方大学及劳动力市场机会的空间差距
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the mechanisms underlying the causal link between childhood location and adulthood economic outcomes. I develop and estimate a dynamic model of individual choice of whether and where to attend college and where to work, accounting for home preferences, spatial search frictions, and moving costs. The estimated model suggests that spatial gaps in college and labor market opportunities, which stem from imperfect mobility in adulthood, play a more important role than variation in childhood neighborhood quality in explaining why children from different counties with similar family backgrounds achieve different economic outcomes in adulthood.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了童年居住地与成年经济结果之间因果联系的机制。我开发并估计了一个关于个体是否上大学、在哪里上大学以及在哪里工作的动态选择模型，考虑了家庭偏好、空间搜索摩擦和迁移成本。估计模型表明，源于成年期不完全流动性的大学和劳动力市场机会的空间差距，在解释来自不同县、家庭背景相似的儿童为何在成年期取得不同经济结果方面，比童年邻里质量的变化起着更重要的作用。
